name: theta-chain-census-parquet
notes: H-census of ADR-0265 on the Parquet tree (Amendment 3): the same census node and the same outputs as run-theta-chain-census.json, fed by the columnar ParquetChainRows reader instead of the gzip unit reader, so every landed root is counted in minutes instead of hours. The two readers give identical node outputs on the same data (tests/pipeline_libs/test_chain_parquet.py, and a real-data parity run on the landed ACMR snapshots in the Amendment). READ-ONLY: /home/russell/data/thetadata/parquet-v2/<tier>/theta/*.parquet (one immutable file per committed snapshot, written by the export driver) is only read; the reader pins the files it listed at fingerprint time, so a run describes exactly the snapshots present when it started. first_bid_date and every share are WHOLE-SAMPLE statistics: a universe gate for a test must be recomputed from dates up to that test's start only. SEALED PERIOD: end_before 2026-01-01 is pushed into the Arrow scan (a later row is never decoded) and sealed_from 2026-01-01 refuses a file whose footer window reaches it; the census node also refuses any row on or after end_before. STITCHING: configs/root-renames.json (sha256-pinned) renames an old root to its new root so a renamed name is one series; an old/new overlap or an effective date the data contradicts refuses. TERCILES use dates before 2021-01-01 only. STRIKE GRID: half-dollar below 200, whole dollars above, a first-pass approximation. CLOSES: the Alpaca as-traded 1-Day SIP bars of the second-300 option universe are wired as the census 'closes' input (price check); as of 2026-10-12 none of the landed roots (A..AG of the tested names) is in that store, so price_compared is 0 until a root of that universe lands; the comparison against the older Yahoo as-traded bars of the tested names is in the ADR amendment. Run from children/index_options: nice -n 10 python -m dskit.pipeline run configs/run-theta-chain-census-parquet.json --asof 2025-12-31.

outputs.notes: A new directory beside the other research runs; nothing is written under /home/russell/data/thetadata. Excluded from the identity hash.

chain.notes: The ThetaData daily chain from the Parquet export tree, symbol by symbol, projected to the seven fields the census reads (column pruning), the sealed period excluded by predicate pushdown and by refusing a whole file whose footer window reaches 2026-01-01. A (symbol, date) unit held by two files comes from the newest-acquired file (footer windows decide; the counters match the gzip reader's). Lazy, re-iterable, read-only. Add a tier directory to directories when its Parquet tree exists.

census.notes: One pass over the stream. A quote is null (a missing side), zero (a side at or below zero), crossed (ask below bid), locked (ask equal to bid) or quoted; usable = locked or quoted. first_bid_date is the first date any contract has a bid above zero: the universe gate of ADR-0265 item 2. iv_error_flag 100 is the vendor's placeholder code (4.3% of rows per ADR-0265). An empty stream, or a row on or after end_before, refuses. CLOSE CHECK: the vendor's underlying_price (one value a day, taken at the chain report time) is compared with the Alpaca as-traded daily close of the same date; price_tolerance 0.01 is a chosen relative tolerance (the report time is not the 16:00 close), so read price_median_abs_rel_diff and price_max_abs_rel_diff, not only the share beyond the tolerance. A split day appears as a large difference on the dates where the vendor and the bars disagree on the split date. SYMBOL REUSE (ADR-0265 Amendment 3): a root can be two companies (a delisted issuer's ticker taken later by another). The detector lists a date as a candidate when the reported price moves by more than a factor of 2 between consecutive priced dates (price_jump) or when the median rows per date over the 10 dates after it differs from the 10 before by more than a factor of 4 AND the near-the-money strikes (within 25% of the price) do not overlap between consecutive dates (rows_shift). A jump whose off-grid strike share rises by 5 points (the split signature of the strike grid below) is counted as split-explained, not listed. These thresholds are chosen conventions; the table is evidence for a person, and a confirmed break is declared in configs/root-renames.json under breaks.

params.source: one row per root: first and last bid date, quote-state shares over all rows and from the first bid date, iv_error placeholder share, median usable quotes per date (all dates and development years), liquidity tercile, non-standard strike rows

coverage.notes: The per-root coverage and quality table; the frozen universe is read from it.

params.source: one row per root and calendar year: rows, dates and rows per date

by_year.notes: Rows per date by year, the thinning of a chain over time.

params.source: one row per root and month: rows, rows at a strike off the listed grid and the distinct such strikes

by_month.notes: Non-standard strikes by month: the corporate-action marker.

params.title: ThetaData option_eod chain census (H-census, Parquet tree)

report.notes: evidence.md renders the run totals, the quote-state counts and the list of checks that did not run (summary.skipped); evidence.json holds every value.

bars.notes: Alpaca 1-Day SIP stock bars, AS-TRADED (the 'raw' source of source-option-universe-300b-bars-raw.json; the 'split' source is split-adjusted and would disagree with the vendor's as-traded underlying_price on every date before a split), 2023-09-01..2025-12-31 for the second-300 option universe. ts is the bar's midnight-Eastern UTC instant, whose first ten characters are the trading date. READ-ONLY. A root of the census that is not in this store (every root landed so far) has no close to compare: it is counted in price_missing_close, not passed as agreeing.

params.source: one row per suspected symbol-reuse break: root, first date of the new regime, previous date, price and rows-per-date before and after, near-the-money strike overlap, split signature and off-grid shares

reuse.notes: The suspected symbol-reuse candidates, read by a person before any series is used as one business.
